top_signals.title: German Finance Chief Says Trump Is to Blame for Surging Yields
top_signals.summary: Germany’s finance minister said President Donald Trump’s war in Iran, which has thrown global energy supplies off balance, was responsible for a surge in bond yields across world markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Strive acquires 1,110 bitcoin for $81.5 million as total holdings reach 21,356 BTC
top_signals.summary: Strive purchased 1,110 bitcoin for $81.5 million, raising its total holdings to 21,356 BTC as the seventh-largest public company holder.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
